literal_meaning: পারলে (if able) + পক্ষে (as much as possible/in favor)
figurative_meaning_en: If possible to avoid, if at all possible
example_sentences_in_bangla: ভিড়ের মধ্যে আমি পারতপক্ষে যাই না।
example_sentences_in_english: Try to steer clear of this task if you can.
note: This idiom is commonly used in spoken Bengali to express preference for avoidance without strong obligation.
